item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:00 PM 30 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Baco, Pinamalayan, Bansud, Gloria), #Romblon(Banton, Calatrava, Concepcion, Corcuera, Odiongan, Romblon, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Ferrol, SantaMaria), #NorthernSamar(Laoang, Palapag, Mapanas, Gamay, Lapinig, Catubig, LasNavas, Pambujan, SilvinoLobos, SanRoque, Mondragon), #CamarinesNorte(Vinzons, Paracale, Talisay, Daet, Labo, SanVicente, SanLorenzoRuiz, Basud, Mercedes), #Masbate(SanPascual and Claveria) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque, #OrientalMindoro(Naujan, Victoria, Socorro and Pola) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
